article: Rescue of Jews by Poles during the Holocaust

divergences.topic: number of Righteous Among the Nations
divergences.en_says: 7,280 people in Poland recognized by January 2023
divergences.evidence_en: By January 2023, 7,280 people in Poland have been recognized
divergences.evidence_other: 已有6,992名波兰人被以色列认定为国际义人

divergences.en_says: report from the Jewish Labour Bund leadership smuggled out by Home Army couriers
divergences.other_says: Witold Pilecki wrote reports on Holocaust and camps, delivered by Jan Karski
divergences.evidence_en: following a report from the Jewish Labour Bund leadership smuggled out of the occupied Poland by Home Army couriers
divergences.evidence_other: 波兰军官威托德·皮雷茨基撰写了关于大屠杀和集中营的报告，经流亡政府信使扬·卡尔斯基传递

divergences.other_says: up to 50,000 Poles executed solely for rescuing Jews
divergences.evidence_other: 其中可能有多达5万人仅因救援犹太人而被德国处决

divergences.en_says: rescue efforts aided by Polish Underground State, Home Army, and Żegota
divergences.other_says: overall help by humanitarian organizations, government-in-exile, underground structures and civilians
divergences.evidence_other: ogół pomocy polskich organizacji humanitarnych, rządu polskiego na uchodźstwie, struktur państwa podziemnego oraz ludności cywilnej RP

divergences.en_says: Any kind of help to Jews was punishable by death, for the rescuer and their family
divergences.evidence_en: Any kind of help to Jews was punishable by death, for the rescuer and their family

summary: EN and ES leads are nearly identical in structure and claims. ZH aligns closely but uses a lower rescuer count, adds Pilecki/Karski names and Polish casualty figures. PL lead is far shorter and more generalized, omitting specifics on death penalty, Żegota, numbers, and individual couriers while framing assistance more broadly as wartime help to Jews.
